company.aboutEn: Changzhou Fengcheng Import And Export Co., Ltd. is a global supplier of full-vehicle covering parts, established in 2025 with 101-200 employees. The company operates a 25,000 sqm factory in Danyang, Jiangsu, equipped with 30 injection molding machines and 9 automated assembly lines. It holds IATF16949, ISO9001, CCC, and E-MARK certifications, ensuring high-quality, precision-engineered automotive components for international markets. We support OEM, ODM, and drawing-based customization with minor customization, sample processing, graphic processing, and customized on demand options.
